status.description: What was RECORDED, not what a Docker daemon confirms — no real orchestrator transitions this table today (RN-243).

imageVersion.description: Version of `artifact.project_image` FROZEN at the first transition (RN-245) — not reapplied on every read.

resources.description: Cap DECLARED at provisioning time — not enforced (RN-248).

pidsLimit.description: Process cap. This is what contains a fork bomb without depending on a verb allowlist.

failureReason.description: Only populated on a transition to `failed`.

401.description: No token, expired token, or invalid signature.

429.description: Rate limit per user or per IP.
